name: Rikkai Daiou
source:
It's a preparation day for the school festival. Main heroine is a tennis club member appointed as a design director. During these four days she must organize work during daytime and patrol classes at the evenings. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
今天是学园祭的准备日。女主角是被任命为设计总监的网球部成员。这四天里，她白天要安排工作，晚上要巡课。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
